summary: (R)-70, or R-70, is a non-hallucinogenic selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor moderate-efficacy partial agonist of the tetrahydropyridinylpyrrolopyridine family related to the psychedelic tryptamines.4-fold relative to the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor and of about 30-fold relative to the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
